name: @561-group/ruinfold-daily
description: Ruinfold Daily: a seeded-daily single-player roguelike run engine (move-log replay, five-way bilattice death, integer scoring). Daily-tournament plumbing (date arithmetic, submission guard, run/score/scored-lock store, leaderboard ranking, submission pipeline) comes from @red-cup-engineering/footing, the extraction of this app's own former src/server/* modules; everything else stays zero-dependency, and Node's native TypeScript type-stripping runs .mts directly.
